options: They were made of the finest leather and true craftsmanship

questions.q: Direct to Indirect: He said, 'I have finished my work.'
options: He says that he had finished.
He told he has finished work.
He said that he had finished his work.
He said that he finished his work.
questions.explanation: Present perfect 'have finished' changes to past perfect 'had finished'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Direct to Indirect: She said, 'Do you know me?'
options: She asked that if I knew her.
She asked if I knew her.
She told do I know her.
questions.explanation: Yes/No questions use 'if/whether' and Simple Past 'knew'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Direct to Indirect: The teacher said to the boys, 'Sit down.'
options: The teacher told to sit down.
The teacher asked boys for sit down.
The teacher said to boys sit down.
The teacher ordered the boys to sit down.
questions.explanation: Imperative command changes to 'ordered + object + to + V1'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Direct to Indirect: Mohan said, 'Alas! I am ruined.'
options: Mohan exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined.
Mohan exclaimed that I am ruined.
Mohan said alas he was ruined.
questions.explanation: 'Alas!' changes to 'exclaimed with sorrow'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Active to Passive: 'The boy killed the snake.'
options: The snake is killed by the boy.
The snake was killed by the boy.
The snake has killed by boy.
questions.explanation: Simple Past active 'killed' -> 'was killed'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Active to Passive: 'Who can do this work?'
options: By whom this work can be done?
By whom can this work be done?
Who can be done this work?
questions.explanation: Interrogative passive with modal 'can' -> 'By whom can + Object + be + V3'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Active to Passive: 'He has written a letter.'
options: A letter has been written by him.
A letter is written by him.
A letter was written by him.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect active 'has written' -> 'has been written'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Active to Passive: 'People speak English all over the world.'
options: English is spoken by people all over world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: General agent 'people' is omitted in passive voice.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Direct to Indirect: He said to her, 'May you succeed!'
options: He wished her that she might succeed.
questions.explanation: Optative sentence 'May you' -> 'wished/prayed... might'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Active to Passive: 'Post this letter.'
questions.explanation: Imperative 'Verb + Object' -> 'Let + Object + be + V3'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She is proficient _____ English.
questions.explanation: 'proficient' takes the preposition 'in'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is addicted _____ smoking.
questions.explanation: 'addicted' takes the preposition 'to'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The bird flew _____ the house.
questions.explanation: 'over' indicates movement directly across and above.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He sat _____ me in the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'beside' means by the side of/next to.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct word: _____ English, he also knows French.
questions.explanation: 'Besides' means 'in addition to'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: Work hard _____ you should fail.
questions.explanation: 'lest' is followed by 'should' to indicate fear of a negative outcome.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: He is poor _____ he is honest.
questions.explanation: 'but' expresses contrast between poor and honest.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: Wait here _____ I return.
questions.explanation: 'until' refers to point of time.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: You will not pass _____ you work hard.
questions.explanation: 'unless' means 'if not' (condition).
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He was born _____ 15th August 1947.
questions.explanation: Specific dates take the preposition 'on'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: When I reached the station, the train _____.
questions.explanation: The earlier of two past actions takes Past Perfect Tense ('had left').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: He _____ here since 2015.
questions.explanation: Action continuing from a point in past takes Present Perfect Continuous.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct degree of comparison: Iron is _____ than any other metal.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree of 'useful' with 'than' is 'more useful'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Superlative degree: No other boy in the class is as tall as Ram.
options: Ram is the tallest boy in the class.
questions.explanation: Superlative form uses 'the tallest'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct transformation: As soon as he saw the tiger, he fled.
options: Hardly he saw tiger when he fled.
No sooner he saw tiger than he fled.
No sooner did he see the tiger than he fled.
questions.explanation: 'As soon as' transforms to 'No sooner did... than...'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct transformation: He is too weak to walk.
options: He is so weak that he cannot walk.
He is very weak to walk.
He is weak so he walks.
questions.explanation: 'too... to' transforms to 'so... that + cannot'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: The number of applicants _____ increasing.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' takes a singular verb.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the Passive Voice: 'They are decorating the hall.'
options: The hall is being decorated by them.
The hall was decorated by them.
The hall is decorated by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous active -> 'is being decorated'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the Passive Voice: 'Somebody stole my bicycle.'
questions.explanation: Simple Past active -> 'was stolen'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the Indirect Speech: He said, 'I can solve this problem.'
options: He says he can solve problem.
He said that he could solve that problem.
He said that I can solve that problem.
He told he could solve this problem.
questions.explanation: 'can' -> 'could', 'this' -> 'that' in Indirect Speech.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the Indirect Speech: She said to me, 'Where do you live?'
options: She asked me where did I live.
She told me where I live.
She asked me that where I lived.
She asked me where I lived.
questions.explanation: Wh-question changes to 'asked + wh-word + assertive order (Simple Past)'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the meaning of the idiom 'A piece of cake'?
